description: A client-side JavaScript module that provides functions for interacting with a backend API, including health checks, file imports, and fetching test suite data. It handles URL resolution based on environment variables or window location, performs fetch requests with error handling, and exposes public functions for API interactions.

methods.name: resolveApiBase()
methods.description: Determines the backend API base URL from environment variables or window location as a fallback.

methods.name: readJsonOrText(resp)
methods.description: Reads the response, parsing JSON if content type indicates, or text otherwise, returning an object.

methods.name: buildUrl(path, query)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL for API requests, appending query parameters.

methods.name: safeFetch(url, options)
methods.description: Wraps fetch with error handling, catching network errors and adding context to error messages.

methods.name: checkBackendHealth()
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the root endpoint to verify backend health.

methods.name: importTestPlanFile(file)
methods.description: Uploads a test plan file to the backend for import.

methods.name: fetchSuites()
methods.description: Fetches all test suites with counts.

methods.name: fetchSuiteTestcases({ suiteId, page = 1, pageSize = 20, category, priority, search })
methods.description: Fetches test cases for a given suite with optional filters and pagination.

methods.name: getApiBase()
methods.description: Returns the currently resolved API base URL for display or debugging.

ctags.name: fetchSuiteTestcases
ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchSuiteTestcases({ suiteId, page = 1, pageSize = 20, category, priority/
ctags.signature: ({ suiteId, page = 1, pageSize = 20, category, priority, search })
